_readme: Edit this file each offseason instead of touching scripts/fetch-rosters.mjs.

You normally shouldn't need to edit it by hand at all: the Admin tab on myffl.html (visible once logged in) edits this same file and commits it, validated by api/save-leagues.js. Hand-editing still works and is the fallback if that endpoint is misconfigured.
Any field added here that the Admin tab doesn't know about is preserved untouched when it saves, so adding one by hand is safe — but do teach the tab about it if it's meant to be editable.
provider: 'mfl' (default if omitted), 'espn', or 'sleeper' — which fetch logic/auth to use. Sleeper needs no auth at all.
id: the league ID for the current year (find it in the league's URL).

franchiseId: your team ID within that league (MFL: 4-digit franchise ID; ESPN: numeric team ID; Sleeper: numeric roster_id, found by matching your username against /v1/league/<id>/users + /v1/league/<id>/rosters).

name: optional fallback display name, used only if the live league/team name can't be fetched. Not editable from the Admin tab, which shows the live name from the last sync instead — editing this changed nothing visible, so the control was removed rather than left looking meaningful. A league added from the Admin tab has no name until its first sync.

type: 'dynasty', 'salarycap', 'draftonly', or 'redraft' — controls which top-level sub-tab a league appears under, in that order. Mostly a display concern, with one exception: 'salarycap' is what adds the Salary/Yrs columns and the cap summary to a card, and what makes the sync fetch the salary cap and salary adjustments at all.

NOTE: 'draftonly' is the type formerly called 'bestball'. Best Ball is a scoring system, not a league type — several salary-cap leagues use best-ball scoring — so it lives in tags now and never appears as a type.

NOTE: there was also a 'format' field ('dynasty' or 'auction'). It is gone. 'auction' always agreed exactly with type 'salarycap', which now drives that behaviour alone, and 'dynasty' was never read by anything. api/save-leagues.js strips the key on save, so it will not come back.

NOTE: only 'dynasty' leagues get DYNASTY FantasyPros rankings. 'salarycap' leagues use DRAFT rankings like draftonly and redraft do — deliberate, despite their contracts and taxi squads, because they're managed on a redraft cadence (cap resets, annual re-auction). Override rankingType on an individual league if one ever needs to differ.
ESPN leagues additionally require ESPN_S2 and ESPN_SWID GitHub Actions secrets (browser cookies, not a login).
Array order is display order everywhere on the page (Rosters, Standings, Scoring).

lineupPilot: MFL or Sleeper. When true, the sync also fetches this week's starters (MFL via TYPE=liveScoring, Sleeper via its matchups endpoint) and the Rosters card shows a checkbox editor instead of the plain Active Roster table. On MFL it's a real editor (login required to actually submit); Sleeper's public API has no write endpoint at all, so its version is permanently read-only regardless of login — checkboxes shown for reference only, no Save button ever. Set on every league that requires a submitted starting lineup.

tags: optional array of extra badge labels shown in the card's upper-right corner (e.g. 'Superflex') — anything not already derivable from type. The type badge (Dynasty/Salary Cap/Draft Only/Redraft) is added automatically, no need to repeat it here. 'Best Ball' is a legitimate tag: it's a scoring system, not a league type. A 'Superflex' tag also switches that league's FantasyPros rankings to their superflex (OP) list.

rankingType: optional FantasyPros ranking set behind the ECR column — defaults to DYNASTY for dynasty leagues and DRAFT for everything else. Switch to ROS once the regular season starts; draft rankings go stale as soon as real games are played. Needs a FANTASYPROS_API_KEY secret — without one the ECR column is simply blank and nothing else changes.
scoring: optional FantasyPros scoring format for the ECR column — 'PPR' (default), 'HALF', or 'STD'.

rulesUrl: optional link to the league's actual rules page/doc. When set, shows a small 📝 icon next to the league name on the Rosters, Standings, and Scoring cards, opening it in a new tab. Omitted entirely for leagues without one.
